Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)
Class: EQ Shotgun
Range: Shotgun Long Barrel
Pre-installed: Magrail Kit (w/Auto-Compensator and Vivisector), Power Rebuild, Shotgun Automatic Control Group, Shotgun Choke, Shotgun Rechamber, Sling, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Shotgun Shell (4d6)

When shells cause a Critical Injury, roll twice on the table and pick one (Vivisector).

Foundry notes:

  • CPR 0.92.4 shows a "weapon doesn't support this mode" warning when a pistol Autofires; it's only a warning and the roll still works.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
